Resolutions of 1956

11 resolutions, 82% unanimous. Founding and early Cold War.

  • 111 (1956) Violations of the cease-fire provisions and of the Israeli-Syrian General Armistice Agreement
  • 112 (1956) Admission of the Sudan to membership in the United Nations
  • 113 (1956) The Palestine question and enforcement of the General Armistice Agreements
  • 114 (1956) The Palestine question and enforcement of the General Armistice Agreements
  • 115 (1956) Admission of Morocco to membership in the United Nations
  • 116 (1956) Admission of Tunisia to membership in the United Nations
  • 117 (1956) Election of members of the International Court of Justice
  • 118 (1956) Requirements for settlement of the Suez question
  • 119 (1956) An emergency special session of the General Assembly on the Suez question
  • 120 (1956) An emergency special session of the General Assembly on the situation in Hungary
  • 121 (1956) Admission of Japan to membership in the United Nations

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.
